column1: # The columns of viafrei-api's schemas as the API's own DDL built them (contract 0.2: db/contract 0001, 0003, 0004;
# access store version 3: db/access 0001-0004), read off that database's catalogue: relation, position, column, type.
# 0307 and 0308 must build exactly these (test/api-schemas.db.test.ts). A change here is a change of the API's contract.
# contract.terms is new in 0312 (the SID terms text, owner 2026-11-16): the API's DDL adds it with contract 0.3.
# contract.departure is new in 0312 (the live departure board, #29): the API's DDL adds it with contract 0.3.
# contract.low_emission_zone, lorry_rule, transit_trip_delay and station_disruption are new in 0312 (#29): the API's DDL adds them with contract 0.3.
# contract.low_emission_zone_entry (the curated zone list) is new in 0312 (#29) too.
